summary:
Aphelios is a platform we built to bring science, technology, and the history of space missions together in one place. Our first release is ISS: Beyond Earth, a 2D game where you play as one of four astronauts living aboard the International Space Station.
You start with a short story, then you're free to walk around the station. We recreated the American, Russian, Japanese, and European modules, using their real names and layouts as closely as we could. Each mission is based on things astronauts actually do up there, like fixing equipment, figuring out technical problems, and running experiments.
We chose this because space science can feel distant, especially for students. A game lets people try the work themselves, so they learn without it feeling like a lecture. It also shows how many countries have to work together to keep the ISS running. We hope players finish a mission and want to know more about space.
details:
Aphelios Project: a Space Expedition is an educational space exploration ;game based on the real-life International Space Station (ISS). The game immerses players into the life of living and working on board the space station.

To start playing the game, players choose from four famous astronauts who each introduce a narrative of the game that sets the background for the main game.

The project includes a fully explorable, interactive 2D pixel-art recreation of the ISS where various international modules are featured. These include the modules of American, Russian, Japanese, and European countries. Each module of the space station is represented according to its country of origin in terms of names, unique visual details, and accurate representation inspired by the actual space station.

Players can participate in interactive missions and activities related to various spheres of expertise like mechanical engineering, maintenance of equipment, scientific experiments, and solving technical problems on board the ISS.

The goal of this project is to provide an opportunity to make space science and engineering more interactive and entertaining.
